  
  

```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(lme4)
library(stringr)  #  for str_extract
library(lmerTest)  # For p-values


library(ggplot2)
library(emmeans)
library(viridis)

```



```{r}
##############################################
# Adjust curr_data and run the following sections.
# Take figs with a grain of salt, as it is very heavily chat induced
##############################################

T <- read.csv("out_to_prevHz_lme_anal.csv")

T$hzDiff <- str_extract(T$cond, "(?<=prev)(low|mid|high)")
T$torder <- as.numeric(str_extract(T$cond, "\\d+$"))

N2_data <- aggregate(trial_amount ~ sub + hzDiff + torder, T[T$sov == "N2",], sum)
Kc_raw <- aggregate(trial_amount ~ sub + hzDiff + torder, T[T$sov == "N2EliwJKc",], sum)
Ss_raw <- aggregate(trial_amount ~ sub + hzDiff + torder, T[T$sov == "N2EliwJSs",], sum)

Kc_data <- merge(Kc_raw, N2_data, by = c("sub", "hzDiff", "torder"), suffixes = c("_Kc", "_N2"))
Kc_data$proportion <- Kc_data$trial_amount_Kc / Kc_data$trial_amount_N2

Ss_data <- merge(Ss_raw, N2_data, by = c("sub", "hzDiff", "torder"), suffixes = c("_Ss", "_N2"))
Ss_data$proportion <- Ss_data$trial_amount_Ss / Ss_data$trial_amount_N2

curr_data = Ss_data ## Kc_data, Ss_data 

```

```{r}
###### MLE analysis

dataset_name <- if(identical(curr_data, Ss_data)) "Ss_data" else "Kc_data"
output_file <- paste0("lme_prevHz_analysis_results_", dataset_name, ".txt")
sink(output_file)  # Redirect output to file


curr_data$torder_ord <- ordered(curr_data$torder)
curr_data$hzDiff_ord <- ordered(curr_data$hzDiff)

# Calculate BF using BIC differences
BF <- function(bic1, bic2) {
    exp((bic1 - bic2)/2)
}

cat("=== LINEAR MIXED-EFFECTS MODEL ANALYSIS RESULTS ===\n")
cat("Date:", format(Sys.time(), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), "\n\n")
cat("=== MODEL COMPARISONS ===\n\n")

# Compare models to test interaction significance
model_null            <- lmer(proportion ~ (1|sub), data = curr_data)
model_hzDiff              <- lmer(proportion ~ hzDiff + (1|sub), data = curr_data)
model_torder          <- lmer(proportion ~ torder + (1|sub), data = curr_data)
model_addative        <- lmer(proportion ~ torder + hzDiff + (1|sub), data = curr_data)
model_interaction     <- lmer(proportion ~ torder * hzDiff + (1|sub), data = curr_data)


cat("1. NULL vs hzDiff MODEL:\n")
print(anova(model_null, model_hzDiff))
cat("BF =", BF(BIC(model_null), BIC(model_hzDiff)), "\n")
cat("\n")

cat("2. NULL vs TORDER MODEL:\n")
print(anova(model_null, model_torder))
cat("BF =", BF(BIC(model_null), BIC(model_torder)), "\n")
cat("\n")

cat("3. hzDiff vs ADDITIVE MODEL:\n")
print(anova(model_hzDiff, model_addative))
cat("BF =", BF(BIC(model_hzDiff), BIC(model_addative)), "\n")
cat("\n")

cat("4. TORDER vs ADDITIVE MODEL:\n")
print(anova(model_torder, model_addative))
cat("BF =", BF(BIC(model_torder), BIC(model_addative)), "\n")
cat("\n")

cat("5. ADDITIVE vs INTERACTION MODEL:\n")
print(anova(model_addative, model_interaction))
cat("BF =", BF(BIC(model_addative), BIC(model_interaction)), "\n")
cat("\n")

# Test interaction
cat("=== FINAL INTERACTION MODEL SUMMARY ===\n")
print(summary(model_interaction))
cat("\n")

cat("=== TYPE III ANOVA TABLE ===\n")
print(anova(model_interaction))
cat("\n")

# Get BIC for all models
all_models_BIC <- data.frame(
  Model = c("Null", "hzDiff only", "Torder only", "Additive", "Interaction"),
  AIC = c(AIC(model_null), AIC(model_hzDiff), AIC(model_torder), AIC(model_addative), AIC(model_interaction)),
  BIC = c(BIC(model_null), BIC(model_hzDiff), BIC(model_torder), BIC(model_addative), BIC(model_interaction)),
  LogLik = c(logLik(model_null), logLik(model_hzDiff), logLik(model_torder), logLik(model_addative), logLik(model_interaction)),
  df = c(attr(logLik(model_null), "df"), 
         attr(logLik(model_hzDiff), "df"), 
         attr(logLik(model_torder), "df"), 
         attr(logLik(model_addative), "df"), 
         attr(logLik(model_interaction), "df"))
)

print(all_models_BIC)

# Calculate BIC differences relative to null model
all_models_BIC$Delta_BIC_from_null <- all_models_BIC$BIC - BIC(model_null)

# Calculate BIC differences relative to best model
best_BIC <- min(all_models_BIC$BIC)
all_models_BIC$Delta_BIC_from_best <- all_models_BIC$BIC - best_BIC

# Calculate Bayes Factors
null_bic <- BIC(model_null)

# BF relative to null model (BF > 1 means evidence against null)
all_models_BIC$BF_vs_null <- sapply(all_models_BIC$BIC, function(x) BF(null_bic, x))

# BF relative to best model (BF > 1 means evidence against the model compared to best)
all_models_BIC$BF_vs_best <- sapply(all_models_BIC$BIC, function(x) BF(best_BIC, x))

print(all_models_BIC)

# Individual BIC values for quick reference
cat("\nIndividual BIC values:\n")
cat("Null model:", BIC(model_null), "\n")
cat("hzDiff model:", BIC(model_hzDiff), "\n") 
cat("Torder model:", BIC(model_torder), "\n")
cat("Additive model:", BIC(model_addative), "\n")
cat("Interaction model:", BIC(model_interaction), "\n")

# Best model
best_model_index <- which.min(all_models_BIC$BIC)
cat("\nBest model (lowest BIC):", all_models_BIC$Model[best_model_index], 
    "with BIC =", all_models_BIC$BIC[best_model_index], "\n")

# Bayes Factor interpretations
cat("\n=== BAYES FACTOR ANALYSIS ===\n\n")

cat("BAYES FACTORS vs NULL MODEL:\n")
for(i in 1:nrow(all_models_BIC)) {
  bf_val <- all_models_BIC$BF_vs_null[i]
  model_name <- all_models_BIC$Model[i]
  
  # Interpretation based on Kass & Raftery (1995) criteria
  if(bf_val < 1) {
    evidence <- "Evidence against"
  } else if(bf_val >= 1 & bf_val < 3) {
    evidence <- "Barely worth mentioning evidence for"
  } else if(bf_val >= 3 & bf_val < 10) {
    evidence <- "Positive evidence for"
  } else if(bf_val >= 10 & bf_val < 30) {
    evidence <- "Strong evidence for"
  } else if(bf_val >= 30 & bf_val < 100) {
    evidence <- "Very strong evidence for"
  } else {
    evidence <- "Decisive evidence for"
  }
  
  cat(sprintf("%-15s: BF = %8.2f (%s)\n", model_name, bf_val, evidence))
}

cat("\nBAYES FACTORS vs BEST MODEL:\n")
best_model_name <- all_models_BIC$Model[best_model_index]
cat("Best model:", best_model_name, "\n")

for(i in 1:nrow(all_models_BIC)) {
  if(i != best_model_index) {
    bf_val <- all_models_BIC$BF_vs_best[i]
    model_name <- all_models_BIC$Model[i]
    
    # Interpretation
    if(bf_val < 1) {
      evidence <- "Evidence against best model"
    } else if(bf_val >= 1 & bf_val < 3) {
      evidence <- "Barely worth mentioning evidence against"
    } else if(bf_val >= 3 & bf_val < 10) {
      evidence <- "Positive evidence against"
    } else if(bf_val >= 10 & bf_val < 30) {
      evidence <- "Strong evidence against"
    } else if(bf_val >= 30 & bf_val < 100) {
      evidence <- "Very strong evidence against"
    } else {
      evidence <- "Decisive evidence against"
    }
    
    cat(sprintf("%-15s: BF = %8.2f (%s)\n", model_name, bf_val, evidence))
  }
}

# Key pairwise comparisons
cat("\n=== KEY MODEL COMPARISONS ===\n")

# hzDiff vs Null
bf_hzDiff_null <- BF(BIC(model_null), BIC(model_hzDiff))
cat(sprintf("hzDiff vs Null:        BF = %8.2f\n", bf_hzDiff_null))

# Torder vs Null  
bf_torder_null <- BF(BIC(model_null), BIC(model_torder))
cat(sprintf("Torder vs Null:    BF = %8.2f\n", bf_torder_null))

# Additive vs hzDiff only
bf_add_hzDiff <- BF(BIC(model_hzDiff), BIC(model_addative))
cat(sprintf("Additive vs hzDiff:    BF = %8.2f\n", bf_add_hzDiff))

# Additive vs Torder only
bf_add_torder <- BF(BIC(model_torder), BIC(model_addative))
cat(sprintf("Additive vs Torder: BF = %8.2f\n", bf_add_torder))

# Interaction vs Additive
bf_int_add <- BF(BIC(model_addative), BIC(model_interaction))
cat(sprintf("Interaction vs Add: BF = %8.2f\n", bf_int_add))

# Post-hoc analysis
cat("\n=== POST-HOC ANALYSIS ===\n\n")

curr_data$torder_factor <- factor(curr_data$torder, levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4))
model_posthoc <- lmer(proportion ~ torder_factor * hzDiff + (1|sub), data = curr_data)

# Get marginal means
emm_torder <- emmeans(model_posthoc, ~ torder_factor)
cat("ESTIMATED MARGINAL MEANS BY TORDER:\n")
print(emm_torder)
cat("\n")

# Get all pairwise comparisons WITHOUT FDR correction first
all_pairs_raw <- pairs(emm_torder, adjust = "none")
pairs_summary_raw <- summary(all_pairs_raw, infer = TRUE)

# Extract only the 3 consecutive comparisons
consecutive_indices <- c(1, 4, 6)  # T1-T2, T2-T3, T3-T4 from the pairs output
consecutive_only <- pairs_summary_raw[consecutive_indices, ]
consecutive_only$p.value.fdr <- p.adjust(consecutive_only$p.value, method = "fdr")

# Get marginal means for hzDiff
emm_hzDiff <- emmeans(model_posthoc, ~ hzDiff)
cat("ESTIMATED MARGINAL MEANS BY hzDiff:\n")
print(emm_hzDiff)

# Get pairwise comparisons for hzDiff
pairs_hzDiff <- pairs(emm_hzDiff, adjust = "fdr")
cat("PAIRWISE COMPARISONS FOR hzDiff:\n")
print(summary(pairs_hzDiff, infer = TRUE))


# Create table with consecutive comparison results
comparison_names <- c("T1_vs_T2", "T2_vs_T3", "T3_vs_T4")

consecutive_table <- data.frame(
  Comparison = comparison_names,
  Difference = round(consecutive_only$estimate, 4),
  SE = round(consecutive_only$SE, 4),
  t_ratio = round(consecutive_only$t.ratio, 2),
  df = consecutive_only$df,
  p_raw = sprintf("%.2e", consecutive_only$p.value),
  p_FDR_corrected = sprintf("%.2e", consecutive_only$p.value.fdr),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

cat("=== CONSECUTIVE COMPARISONS TABLE ===\n")
print(consecutive_table, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n")

# Clean table for manuscript
manuscript_table <- data.frame(
  Comparison = comparison_names,
  `Mean Difference` = sprintf("%.4f", consecutive_only$estimate),
  `95% CI` = paste0("[", sprintf("%.4f", consecutive_only$lower.CL), ", ", 
                    sprintf("%.4f", consecutive_only$upper.CL), "]"),
  `t` = sprintf("%.2f", consecutive_only$t.ratio),
  `p (FDR-corrected)` = sprintf("%.2e", consecutive_only$p.value.fdr),
  check.names = FALSE
)

cat("=== MANUSCRIPT-READY TABLE ===\n")
print(manuscript_table, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\n")

# Extract key statistics for manuscript
cat("=== KEY STATISTICS FOR MANUSCRIPT ===\n")
model_summary <- summary(model_interaction)
anova_summary <- anova(model_interaction)

cat("MAIN EFFECTS:\n")
cat("- Torder: F(", anova_summary$NumDF[1], ",", round(anova_summary$DenDF[1]), ") = ", 
    round(anova_summary$`F value`[1], 2), ", p = ", 
    ifelse(anova_summary$`Pr(>F)`[1] < 0.001, 
           sprintf("%.2e", anova_summary$`Pr(>F)`[1]), 
           round(anova_summary$`Pr(>F)`[1], 3)), "\n")

cat("  Beta = ", sprintf("%.3e", model_summary$coefficients[2, 1]), 
    ", t = ", round(model_summary$coefficients[2, 4], 2),
    ", p = ", sprintf("%.2e", model_summary$coefficients[2, 5]), "\n")

cat("- hzDiff: F(", anova_summary$NumDF[2], ",", round(anova_summary$DenDF[2]), ") = ", 
    round(anova_summary$`F value`[2], 2), ", p = ", 
    ifelse(anova_summary$`Pr(>F)`[2] < 0.001, 
           sprintf("%.2e", anova_summary$`Pr(>F)`[2]), 
           round(anova_summary$`Pr(>F)`[2], 3)), "\n")

cat("  Beta = ", sprintf("%.3e", model_summary$coefficients[3, 1]), 
    ", t = ", round(model_summary$coefficients[3, 4], 2),
    ", p = ", sprintf("%.2e", model_summary$coefficients[3, 5]), "\n")

cat("INTERACTION:\n")
cat("- Torder x hzDiff: F(", anova_summary$NumDF[3], ",", round(anova_summary$DenDF[3]), ") = ", 
    round(anova_summary$`F value`[3], 2), ", p = ", 
    ifelse(anova_summary$`Pr(>F)`[3] < 0.001, 
           sprintf("%.2e", anova_summary$`Pr(>F)`[3]), 
           round(anova_summary$`Pr(>F)`[3], 3)), "\n")

cat("  Beta = ", sprintf("%.3e", model_summary$coefficients[4, 1]), 
    ", t = ", round(model_summary$coefficients[4, 4], 2),
    ", p = ", sprintf("%.2e", model_summary$coefficients[4, 5]), "\n")

cat("\n=== BAYES FACTOR SUMMARY FOR MANUSCRIPT ===\n")
cat("Model selection based on BIC and Bayes Factors:\n")
cat("- Best model:", best_model_name, "(lowest BIC)\n")
cat("- Evidence for best model vs null: BF =", all_models_BIC$BF_vs_null[best_model_index], "\n")

if(best_model_name != "Interaction") {
  int_index <- which(all_models_BIC$Model == "Interaction")
  cat("- Evidence against interaction model: BF =", all_models_BIC$BF_vs_best[int_index], "\n")
}

cat("\n=== ANALYSIS COMPLETE ===\n")
cat("Results saved to:", output_file, "\n")

# Close the sink to return output to console
sink()

# Print confirmation message to console
cat("Analysis complete! Results saved to:", output_file, "\n")
cat("File location:", file.path(getwd(), output_file), "\n")
```

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(emmeans)

# Create plots for main effects
# Assuming curr_data and model_interaction are already available

# 1. Main effect of torder (tone repetition)
# Calculate marginal means for torder
curr_data$torder_factor <- factor(curr_data$torder, levels = c(1, 2, 3, 4))
model_for_plots <- lmer(proportion ~ torder_factor * hzDiff + (1|sub), data = curr_data)

# Get marginal means
emm_torder <- emmeans(model_for_plots, ~ torder_factor)
torder_means <- summary(emm_torder)

# Plot 1: Main effect of tone repetition
p1 <- ggplot(torder_means, aes(x = torder_factor, y = emmean)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "blue") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), 
                width = 0.1, color = "blue") +
  geom_line(aes(group = 1), color = "blue", size = 1) +
  labs(title = paste("Main Effect of Tone Repetition -", dataset_name),
       x = "Tone Repetition (T1-T4)",
       y = "Proportion of Events") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12))

print(p1)

# 2. Main effect of hzDiff (frequency difference)
# Get marginal means for hzDiff
emm_hzDiff <- emmeans(model_for_plots, ~ hzDiff)
hzDiff_means <- summary(emm_hzDiff)

# Reorder factor levels for logical ordering
hzDiff_means$hzDiff <- factor(hzDiff_means$hzDiff, levels = c("low", "mid", "high"))

# Plot 2: Main effect of frequency difference
p2 <- ggplot(hzDiff_means, aes(x = hzDiff, y = emmean)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, color = "red") +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), 
                width = 0.1, color = "red") +
  geom_line(aes(group = 1), color = "red", size = 1) +
  labs(title = paste("Main Effect of Frequency Difference -", dataset_name),
       x = "Previous Tone Frequency",
       y = "Proportion of Events") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12))

print(p2)

# 3. Interaction plot (optional)
# Get marginal means for the interaction
emm_interaction <- emmeans(model_for_plots, ~ torder_factor | hzDiff)
interaction_means <- summary(emm_interaction)
interaction_means$hzDiff <- factor(interaction_means$hzDiff, levels = c("low", "mid", "high"))

# Plot 3: Interaction plot
p3 <- ggplot(interaction_means, aes(x = torder_factor, y = emmean, color = hzDiff)) +
  geom_point(size = 3, position = position_dodge(0.2)) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL), 
                width = 0.1, position = position_dodge(0.2)) +
  geom_line(aes(group = hzDiff), size = 1, position = position_dodge(0.2)) +
  labs(title = paste("Interaction: Tone Repetition × Frequency Difference -", dataset_name),
       x = "Tone Repetition (T1-T4)",
       y = "Proportion of Events",
       color = "Frequency") +
  scale_color_viridis_d() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14),
        axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10))

print(p3)

# Save plots
ggsave(paste0("main_effect_torder_", dataset_name, ".png"), plot = p1, 
       width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave(paste0("main_effect_hzDiff_", dataset_name, ".png"), plot = p2, 
       width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave(paste0("interaction_plot_", dataset_name, ".png"), plot = p3, 
       width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

cat("Plots saved successfully!\n")
```
